crafts.title: Pattachitra
crafts.description: Notice the painted borders and fine detail. Raghurajpur is known for this traditional painting practice.
crafts.alt: Odisha Pattachitra painting displayed at Raghurajpur

crafts.title: Pipili appliqué
crafts.description: Look for the edges where pieces of colored cloth are stitched together. Chandua is used for canopies, umbrellas and other decorations.
crafts.alt: Bright appliqué textiles displayed in Pipili
crafts.author: Rahul Mukherjee

crafts.title: Tarakasi silver filigree
crafts.description: Follow the thin silver wires that form the open pattern. Cuttack is a center for this metalwork.
crafts.alt: Examples of traditional silver filigree from Cuttack
crafts.author: Government of Odisha
